description: Long-poll a durable Nofax request for up to 240 seconds. If the result is pending, you MUST call this tool again with the same requestId. Repeat indefinitely until a terminal response is returned or the user explicitly changes/cancels the goal. Do not continue the guarded action while pending.

requestId.description: Durable request handle returned by a nofax_request_* tool.

waitSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to long-poll during this call; defaults to 240. A timeout still returns pending, never approval.

name: nofax_wait_for_response

decision.description: Terminal human decision when resolved, such as allow, deny, refine, or an explicit choice value.

instruction.description: Safety-preserving instruction describing what the caller may do next.

mustWait.description: Present and true while the request remains pending.

status.description: Whether the human request is still pending or has reached a terminal response.

text.description: Human free-text refinement when the terminal decision is refine.

title: Wait for Nofax human response
